questions.question: Explain the difference between sharing and grouping using 84 divided by 4 and 96 divided by 8, and show how each is a multiplication read backwards.
questions.expected_answer: 84 divided by 4 is sharing 84 sweets among 4 friends; it asks which number times 4 is 84, and 4 times 21 is 84, so 21 each. 96 divided by 8 is grouping 96 learners into rows of 8; it asks which number times 8 is 96, and 8 times 12 is 96, so 12 rows.

questions.question: Work out 372 divided by 6 by chunking, showing each chunk and what is left, and check the answer.
questions.expected_answer: Take 6 times 50, which is 300: 72 left. Take 6 times 10, which is 60: 12 left. Take 6 times 2, which is 12: 0 left. Chunks 50 plus 10 plus 2 give 62. Check: 6 times 62 is 372.

questions.question: Work out 375 divided by 6, explain what the remainder means, and explain why a remainder of 9 would be wrong.
questions.expected_answer: 375 divided by 6 is 62 remainder 3: 62 full boxes and 3 loaves left over. Check: 6 times 62 is 372, plus 3 is 375. A remainder of 9 would be wrong because 9 is more than 6, so another full box of 6 could be made, leaving 3.
